Results.ReviewText:
It exceeded my expectations for grilling performance - does better than my large Weber ever did - I think probably the small size gets heated faster and hotter which makes a better hamburger.

It falls short in ergonomics.  First, the grill side shelves fold in nicely, but I wish Weber would have designed a one-handed carry system; the two-handed carry works, but it would be better with one hand and one side handle is partially blocked by the gas regulator so a person doesn't get full use of that handle making it sort of awkward.  Second, the gas connection is a little hard to get to because it's tucked under the handle also and because the grill is so short you have to get really low to line up the gas line or bottle with the connection.  Overall, I give it 4 stars because of it's performance - the ergonomic shortfalls are manageable.
Results.Title: Cooks Awesome - Could Use Some Design Changes

Results.ReviewText: I knew when I bought this grill it was going to be a good grill, what I didn't realize was that it was going to beat even those expectations. It's aesthetically appealing, assembly took a very short amount of time and was not complicated. But the best part was turning it on and trying it for the first time. I know you have to "learn" every grill, where the hot spots and cold spots are when it's on, so was expecting a learning curve. Didn't expect that there were no hot or cold spots with this grill, everything cooked evenly no matter where it was on the grill. In my experience, small grills with only a few burners tend to take awhile to master this but with the Q, not a problem at all! So happy with the purchase, use it in my backyard and take it camping. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: Exceeded Expectations

Results.ReviewText:
We bought this bbq after trying another brand to use for camping. The other model we tried was larger and significantly heavier than the Webber Q1200. The slightly smaller grill size and lighter overall weight was far more appropriate for our purposes. The bbq cooks well across the entire cooking surface with no major hot spots. 
As mentioned somewhere before, the right hand hold is very difficult to hang onto. This is because the mechanism where the propane bottle attaches is mounted to high and interferes with the hand hold.
Overall we are enjoying the bbq and are very pleased with it. Only time will tell how it holds up in the long term.
